connector.name: Attestor
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted memory for agent teams. Bi-temporal replay, deterministic retrieval, audit log.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package attestor. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bolnet account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATTESTOR_PATH
env.description: Directory containing attestor's config.toml. Defaults to ~/.attestor.

env.name: ATTESTOR_DISABLE_LOCAL_EMBED
env.description: Set to 1 to skip the local Ollama embedder probe (e.g., on hosts without Ollama). Defaults to unset (Ollama is the default embedder).

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (used for the OpenAI text-embedding-3-large fallback embedder when Ollama is unavailable).

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key (used for the federated LLM extraction / consolidation paths and for the LongMemEval benchmark runner).
